annotation.long_name: lake ID from prior database
annotation.comment: Identifier of prior lake from the prior lake database. The format of the identifier is CBBNNNNNNT, where C=continent code, B=basin code, N=lake counter within the basin, T=type.

annotation.long_name: list of reach ID(s) intersecting this lake
annotation.comment: If this PLD lake is a connected lake, this attribute provides the list of the identifiers of the river reaches (i.e. reach_id attribute in the PRD) of type “Connected lake” (i.e. ending with digit 3) that are related to it.

annotation.long_name: Identifier(s) of the observed lake(s)
annotation.comment: List of identifiers of observed lakes that intersect the prior lake given by lake_id. Unique observation identifier within the product. The format of the identifier is CBBTTTSNNNNNN, where C=continent code, B=basin code, TTT=tile number within the pass, S=swath side, N=lake counter within the tile. The different identifiers are separated by semicolons.

annotation.long_name: fraction of prior lake covered by each observed lake
annotation.comment: List of fractions of prior lake area covered by each observed lake identified in obs_id attribute. The different fractions are separated by semicolons and refer one-to-one to the identifiers listed in the obs_id attribute.

annotation.long_name: number of observed lake(s) intersecting the PLD lake
annotation.comment: Number of observed lake(s) intersecting the PLD lake. This attribute provides the number of elements in obs_id and overlap attributes.

annotation.long_name: time (UTC)
annotation.tai_utc_difference: [value of TAI-UTC at time of first record]
annotation.comment: Time of measurement in seconds in the UTC time scale since 1 Jan 2000 00:00:00 UTC. [tai_utc_difference] is the difference between TAI and UTC reference time (seconds) for the first measurement of the data set. If a leap second occurs within the data set, the attribute leap_second is set to the UTC time at which the leap second occurs.

annotation.long_name: time (TAI)
annotation.comment: Time of measurement in seconds in the TAI time scale since 1 Jan 2000 00:00:00 TAI. This time scale contains no leap seconds. The difference (in seconds) with time in UTC is given by the attribute [time:tai_utc_difference].

annotation.long_name: UTC time
annotation.tai_utc_difference: [value of TAI-UTC at time of first record]
annotation.comment: Time string giving UTC time. The format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ, where the Z suffix indicates UTC time.

annotation.long_name: time difference in seconds from the previous crossover
annotation.comment: Time difference in seconds from the previous crossover-calibration location (nominally positive).

annotation.long_name: time difference in seconds to the next crossover
annotation.comment: Time difference in seconds to the next crossover-calibration location (nominally negative).

annotation.long_name: lake-averaged water surface elevation with respect to the geoid
annotation.comment: Lake-averaged water surface elevation, relative to the provided model of the geoid (geoid_hght), with corrections for media delays (wet and dry troposphere, and ionosphere), crossover correction, and tidal effects (solid_tide, load_tidef, and pole_tide) applied.

annotation.long_name: total uncertainty in lake water surface elevation
annotation.comment: Total one-sigma uncertainty (random and systematic) in the lake WSE, including uncertainties of corrections and references.

annotation.long_name: random-only uncertainty in the height water surface elevation
annotation.comment: Random-only component in the lake water surface elevation, including uncertainties of corrections and references, and variation about the fit.

annotation.long_name: standard deviation of pixels wse
annotation.comment: Standard deviation of the water surface elevation of all the pixels composing the lake. Note that this value is therefore with respect to the provided model of the geoid (geoid_hght attribute) whereas the height of pixels is given with respect to the ellipsoid.

annotation.long_name: number of pixels used to compute wse
annotation.comment: Number of pixel cloud samples that have been involved in the computation of wse.

annotation.long_name: constrained lake-averaged water surface elevation with respect to the geoid
annotation.comment: Spatially constrained estimate of WSE that is computed only from pixels within the PLD polygon. For most PLD lakes greater than 100 km2, a SWOT-derived differential mean lake surface is taken into account.

annotation.long_name: total uncertainty in constrained lake water surface elevation
annotation.comment: Total uncertainty (random and systematic) in the constrained lake WSE. The value includes uncertainties of corrections and references.

annotation.long_name: random-only uncertainty in the constrained water surface elevation
annotation.comment: Random-only component of the uncertainty in the constrained lake WSE.

annotation.long_name: standard deviation of pixels wse2
annotation.comment: Standard deviation of the constrained lake WSE.

annotation.long_name: number of pixels used to compute wse2
annotation.comment: Number of pixel cloud samples that have been involved in the computation of wse2.

annotation.long_name: total water area with estimate of dark water
annotation.comment: Total estimated area, including dark water that was not detected as water in the SWOT observation but identified through the use of a prior water likelihood map.

annotation.long_name: uncertainty in total water area
annotation.comment: Total uncertainty (random and systematic) in the total water area.

annotation.long_name: area of detected water pixels
annotation.comment: Aggregation of used detected pixels area.

annotation.long_name: uncertainty in area of detected water
annotation.comment: Total uncertainty (random and systematic) in the area of detected water pixels.

annotation.long_name: number of pixels used to compute area_total
annotation.comment: Number of pixel cloud samples that have been assigned to the lake, and are therefore involved in the computation of area_total.

annotation.long_name: metric of layover effect
annotation.comment: Value indicating an estimate of the height error due to layover.

annotation.long_name: distance of lake polygon centroid to the satellite ground track
annotation.comment: Distance of centroid of polygon delineating lake boundary to the satellite ground track. A negative value indicates the left side of the swath, relative to the spacecraft velocity vector. A positive value indicates the right side of the swath.

annotation.long_name: storage change computed with direct approach and linear model for bathymetry
annotation.comment: "Storage change relative to the first SWOT valid measurement

annotation.long_name: uncertainty in storage change computed with direct approach and linear model for bathymetry
annotation.comment: Uncertainty in storage change computed with the direct approach, and considering a linear model for the lake bathymetry.

annotation.long_name: storage change computed with direct approach and quadratic model for bathymetry
annotation.comment: "Storage change relative to the first SWOT measurement

annotation.long_name: uncertainty in storage change computed with direct approach and quadratic model for bathymetry
annotation.comment: Uncertainty in storage change computed with the direct approach, and considering a quadratic model for the lake bathymetry.

annotation.long_name: storage change computed with incremental approach and linear model for bathymetry
annotation.comment: "Storage change relative to the first SWOT valid measurement

annotation.long_name: uncertainty in storage change computed with incremental approach and linear model for bathymetry
annotation.comment: Uncertainty in storage change computed with the incremental approach, and considering a linear model for the lake bathymetry.

annotation.long_name: storage change computed with incremental approach and quadratic model for bathymetry
annotation.comment: "Storage change relative to the first SWOT measurement

annotation.long_name: uncertainty in storage change computed with incremental approach and quadratic model for bathymetry
annotation.comment: Uncertainty in storage change computed with the incremental approach, and considering a quadratic model for the lake bathymetry.

annotation.long_name: summary quality indicator for lake measurement
annotation.comment: Summary quality flag for the lake measurement. A value of 0 indicates a nominal measurement, 1 indicates a suspect measurement, 2 indicates a degraded measurement, and 3 indicates a bad measurement.

annotation.long_name: bitwise quality indicator for the lake
annotation.flag_meanings: classification_qual_suspect geolocation_qual_suspect few_open_water_suspect wse_std_suspect diff_from_pld_area_suspect xovr_cal_suspect no_prior_suspect water_false_detection_rate_suspect classification_qual_degraded geolocation_qual_degraded low_coh_degraded specular_ringing_degraded low_coh_bad xovr_cal_bad specular_ringing_bad
annotation.comment: Bitwise quality indicator for the lake measurements. If this attribute is interpreted as an unsigned integer, a value of 0 indicates good data, values greater than 0 but less than 16384 represent suspect data, values greater than or equal to 16384 but less than 4194304 represent degraded data, and values greater than or equal to 4194304 represent bad data.

annotation.long_name: fractional area of pixels used to compute wse
annotation.comment: Ratio of the area of the pixels used to compute wse to the lake area_total. This value is between 0 and 1, with 1 indicating 100% of pixels used.

annotation.long_name: fractional area of pixels within the PLD polygon
annotation.comment: Fraction of lake area_total that is within the PLD polygon. This value is between 0 and 1, with 1 indicating 100%.

annotation.long_name: fractional area of pixels used to compute wse2
annotation.comment: Ratio of the area of pixels used to compute wse2 to the lake area_total. This value is between 0 and 1, with 1 indicating 100% of pixels used.

annotation.long_name: fractional area of water-near-land pixels
annotation.comment: Fraction of lake area_total covered by water-near-land pixels. This value is between 0 and 1, with 0 indicating no water-near-land pixels and 1 indicating 100% water-near-land pixels.

annotation.long_name: fractional area of dark water
annotation.comment: Fraction of lake area_total covered by dark water. The value is between 0 and 1.

annotation.long_name: fractional area of low-coherence pixels
annotation.comment: Fraction of lake area_total covered by low-coherence pixels. The value is between 0 and 1.

annotation.long_name: fractional area of pixels with specular ringing
annotation.comment: Fraction of lake area_total covered by pixels degraded by specular ringing. The value is between 0 and 1.

annotation.long_name: climatological ice cover flag
annotation.comment: Climatological ice cover flag indicating whether the lake is ice-covered on the day of the observation based on external climatological information (not the SWOT measurement). Values of 0, 1, and 2 indicate that the lake is likely not ice covered, may or may not be partially or fully ice covered, and likely fully ice covered, respectively.

annotation.long_name: dynamical ice cover flag
annotation.comment: Dynamic ice cover flag indicating whether the lake is ice-covered on the day of the observation, based on SWOT radar signal characteristics. Values of 0, 1, and 2 indicate that the lake is likely not ice-covered, likely partially ice-covered, and likely fully ice-covered, respectively. A value of -999 indicates that the method was unable to predict the lake’s ice condition.

annotation.long_name: partially covered lake flag
annotation.comment: Flag that indicates only partial lake coverage. 0= Indicates that the observed lake is entirely covered by the swath. 1= Indicates that the observed lake is partially covered by the swath.

annotation.long_name: quality of the cross-over calibration
annotation.comment: Quality of the cross-over calibration. A value of 0 indicates a nominal measurement, 1 indicates a suspect measurement, and 2 indicates a bad measurement.

Unweighted mean of the sigma0 of the pixels used to determine the lake wse. The value is provided as a linear power ratio, not a value in decibels. A decibel value may be obtained from: sig0_in_dB = 10*log10(sig0).

annotation.long_name: uncertainty in sigma0
annotation.comment: Uncertainty of sig0.The value is provided in linear units.This value is a one-sigma additive (not multiplicative) uncertainty term, which can be added to or subtracted from sig0.

annotation.long_name: standard deviation of sigma0
annotation.comment: Standard deviation of the sigma0 of the pixels used to compute lake wse. The value is provided in linear units.

annotation.long_name: constrained sigma0
annotation.comment: Unweighted mean of the sigma0 of the pixels involved in the computation of wse2. The value is provided as a linear power ratio, not a value in decibels. A decibel value may be obtained from: sig0_2_in_dB = 10*log10(sig0_2).

annotation.long_name: uncertainty in constrained sigma0
annotation.comment: Uncertainty of sig0_2.The value is provided in linear units.This value is a one-sigma additive (not multiplicative) uncertainty term, which can be added to or subtracted from sig0_2.

annotation.long_name: standard deviation of pixels sigma0
annotation.comment: Standard deviation of the sigma0 of the pixels used to computed wse. The value is provided in linear units.

annotation.long_name: polarization of sigma0
annotation.comment: Flag indicating whether the node is observed with a horizontal (H) or vertical (V) signal polarization. For large lakes covered by the whole swath, the flag is “H+V”.

annotation.long_name: geoid height
annotation.comment: Lake-averaged geoid model height above the reference ellipsoid. The value is computed from the EGM2008 geoid model with a correction to refer the value to the mean tide system (i.e., includes the zero-frequency permanent tide).

annotation.long_name: difference between EGM2008 geoid model and SWOT mean lake surface
annotation.comment: Difference between EGM2008 geoid model and SWOT-observed mean lake surface for the majority of PLD lakes >100 km2 (approx. 1400 lakes). Set to 0 for the other PLD lakes.

annotation.long_name: solid Earth tide height
annotation.source: Cartwright and Taylor (1971) and Cartwright and Edden (1973)
annotation.comment: Solid-Earth (Body) tide height, averaged over the lake. The zero-frequency permanent tide component is not included.

annotation.long_name: geocentric load tide height (FES)
annotation.comment: Geocentric load tide height. The effect of the ocean tide loading of the Earth’s crust. This value is used to compute wse.

annotation.long_name: geocentric load tide height (GOT)
annotation.comment: Geocentric load tide height. The effect of the ocean tide loading of the Earth’s crust.

annotation.long_name: height of pole tide
annotation.comment: Geocentric pole tide height. The sum total of the contribution from the solid-Earth (body) pole tide height and the load pole tide height (i.e., the effect of the ocean pole tide loading of the Earth’s crust).

annotation.long_name: dry tropospheric vertical correction to WSE
annotation.source: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasting
annotation.comment: Equivalent vertical correction due to dry troposphere delay. Adding the reported correction to the reported lake WSE results in the uncorrected lake WSE.

annotation.long_name: wet tropospheric vertical correction to WSE
annotation.source: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasting
annotation.comment: Equivalent vertical correction due to wet troposphere delay. Adding the reported correction to the reported lake WSE results in the uncorrected lake WSE.

annotation.long_name: ionospheric vertical correction to WSE
annotation.comment: Equivalent vertical correction due to ionosphere delay. Adding the reported correction to the reported lake WSE results in the uncorrected lake WSE.

annotation.long_name: crossover calibration height correction
annotation.comment: Equivalent height correction estimated from KaRIn crossover calibration. The correction is applied during processing before geolocation in terms of roll, baseline dilation, etc., but reported as an equivalent height correction. The correction term should be subtracted from the reported WSE to obtain the uncorrected WSE.

annotation.long_name: name(s) of the lake
annotation.comment: Name(s) of the lake, retrieved from Open Street Map, IGN Carthage, GLWD and vMap0 databases. The different names are separated by semicolons.

annotation.long_name: reservoir Id from GRanD database
annotation.comment: Reservoir ID from the Global Reservoir and Dam (GRanD) database. 0=The lake is not a registered reservoir.

annotation.long_name: longitude of the deepest point of the prior lake
annotation.comment: Longitude of the deepest point of the prior lake.

annotation.long_name: latgitude of the deepest point of the prior lake
annotation.comment: Latitude of the deepest point of the prior lake.

annotation.long_name: reference water surface elevation
annotation.comment: Reference water surface elevation from the prior lake database, used to compute storage change.

annotation.long_name: reference water surface area
annotation.comment: Reference water surface area from the prior lake database, used to compute storage change.

annotation.long_name: reference date for the storage change attributes
annotation.comment: Reference date from the prior lake database for the storage change attributes, corresponding to the date of the first valid measurement. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

annotation.long_name: reference storage change
annotation.comment: Reference storage change from the prior lake database used to translate the storage change values initially computed with respect to the p_ref_wse and p_ref_area of the PLD lake, to the storage change relative to p_date_t0.

annotation.long_name: maximum water storage
annotation.comment: Maximum water storage value from the prior lake database, computed between the minimum (or ground when a bathymetry is available) and maximum observed levels of the lake.
